description: Land Acquisition - Vellaimanal, Town & Gravets D/S Division, Trincomalee District - Wellamadama, Matara D/S Division, Matara District - Amendment to the notice published in Gaz. Ex. Ord. No. 1958/13 of 16.03.2016 by Ridigama D/S Division
categorisation: This gazette exclusively contains land acquisition notices under the Land Acquisition Act, detailing specific land parcels to be acquired for public purposes. The content focuses entirely on land descriptions, boundaries, extents, and acquisition procedures, falling squarely within the Land Gazettes category (Type 4) for land and property-related matters.
